siteBlock.Description of Business Type / Industry: Argenta Manufacturing Limited is an animal health pharmaceutical manufacturer. The company produces a wide range of bespoke animal health products for both local and export markets. Argenta is the largest animal health pharmaceutical manufacturer in the Southern Hemisphere and also provides contract manufacturing services to other businesses in OECD countries. Its Manurewa facility is GMP-certified and meets the requirements of major regulatory agencies, including the European Medicines Agency (EMA) and the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA). The site is supported by highly competent health and safety practitioners and strong compliance programmes.
siteBlock.Brief location summary: Argenta Pharmaceuticals stores 1000kg of SODIUM LAURYL SULPHATE (SLS), a class 4.1.1A flammable solid surfactant, in a Type D storage room maintained at ambient temperature. The storage area, identified as Room 004 on the Argenta site plan, is secured by lock and key and access is restricted to authorised personnel. Based on its physical and chemical properties, the substance is not classified as self-igniting.

trailing.declaration: Declaration: I verify that I have examined the evidence and conducted the compliance audit as per Regulation 10.36 of the Health and Safety at Work (Hazardous Substances) Regulations 2017. All photographs in the report were personally taken by me at the specified site on the date of the report, unless stated otherwise within the report (IPS Clause 21(4)).Please note that this audit utilized an iPad and tape measure, with appropriate personal protective equipment worn on-site (IPS Clause 21(1)(d)). The issuance of a compliance certificate has been validated through inquiry, inspection, assessment, or examination, as detailed in this report (IPS Clause 21(1)(e)).
